name: usbip-win2
purpose: USB/IP virtual host controller driver for the VM side of usb-v1 (docs/usb-redirection.md)
publishedBy: Open Source Codesigning Initiative (OSSign), mirror of the upstream driver build

signature.how: Get-AuthenticodeSignature and WinVerifyTrust (embedded signature of each .sys and .cat; catalog membership of each .sys and .inf) on a downloaded copy, nothing installed
signature.issuer: Microsoft Windows Third Party Component CA 2014
signature.timestamp: Microsoft Time-Stamp Service (the signing certificate itself expired 2026-07-15; the timestamp keeps the signatures valid)
signature.kind: Microsoft attestation signing. Windows 10/11 desktop load it; Windows Server needs HLK-signed drivers and is not supported.

notes: The files are never edited, re-signed or test-signed; they are not stored in this repository. tools/fetch-usb-drivers.ps1 downloads them into .tools/usb-drivers and checks every SHA-256; the Host package carries them as bin/usb-driver/.
The upstream installer and tools (usbip.exe, the GUI, the detach-on-shutdown task) are never run or shipped.

The INF turns on debugging registry values (Parameters\VerboseOn, Parameters\Wdf\VerifierOn, NumberOfUsb20Ports/NumberOfUsb30Ports 30); the registry values are not signed content, so the Host switches the debugging ones off after installing.
The INF device object is world read/write by design; the Host restricts it to SYSTEM and Administrators and proves that before attaching anything (usb_driver.hpp).

Not verified: Memory Integrity (HVCI) compatibility, soak behaviour. Upstream 0.9.7.8 shipped a BSOD bug fixed in 0.9.8.0; 0.9.8.1 is an AI-assisted review release that warns of regressions. 0.9.7.5 predates both and was chosen for being the newest release whose driver files could be checked directly.
